products.description: Whole-home water softening designed to address hardness minerals that contribute to scale, spotting, and cleaning challenges. Select the system configuration with guidance on your water conditions.
products.name: Refine - 15

products.description: Whole-home water softening designed to address hardness minerals that contribute to scale, spotting, and cleaning challenges. Select the system configuration with guidance on your water conditions.
products.name: Refine - 20

products.description: Whole-home carbon filtration with automatic media rinsing, intended to help address unwanted taste, odor, and certain compounds where supported by the selected media and verified performance documentation.
products.name: Essence - 15

products.description: Whole-home carbon filtration with automatic media rinsing, intended to help address unwanted taste, odor, and certain compounds where supported by the selected media and verified performance documentation.
products.name: Essence - 20

products.description: CLEAR whole-home water conditioning paired with Pureline Solo: one replaceable carbon cartridge. Carbon filtration is intended to address applicable taste, odor, and compounds; specific removal claims require verified performance documentation.
products.name: Harmony - Pureline Solo

products.description: CLEAR whole-home water conditioning paired with Pureline Duo: two replaceable cartridges, sediment followed by carbon. Filtration is intended to address applicable taste, odor, and compounds; specific removal claims require verified performance documentation.
products.name: Harmony - Pureline Duo

products.description: CLEAR whole-home water conditioning paired with Pureline Trio: three replaceable cartridges for sediment, iron, and carbon. Filtration suitability depends on the water conditions and cartridge specifications; specific removal claims require verification.
products.name: Harmony - Pureline Trio

products.description: CLEAR whole-home water conditioning with a pass-through valve and no Pureline or Big Blue cartridge filters. This configuration does not provide cartridge-based treatment for taste, odor, or compounds.
products.name: Harmony - Pass-Through Valve

products.description: Five-stage point-of-use reverse osmosis filtration for drinking and cooking water. Actual performance depends on the source water, installed components, and maintenance.
products.name: Origin - Five Stage

products.description: Six-stage point-of-use reverse osmosis filtration for drinking and cooking water, including an Alkaline Enhancer remineralization cartridge as the additional stage.
products.name: Origin - Six Stage with Alkaline Enhancer
